intent: Explain node swap for ui-canvas and ui-icon, where the bitmap lives on the instance.
lastDone: ui-canvas 2d context and ImageBitmap are instance fields; no disconnectedCallback; data-src repaints only a real upgraded canvas
blobImageMap is keyed by Blob object, so a new fetch misses the decoded bitmap
ui-icon phosphor paint is :host CSS and survives if the icon attribute is on the new tag
resource icons keep the URL in #resourceImageUrl and a shadow img; connectedCallback rebuilds only from the resource attribute
next: If asked, publish a slot from disconnectedCallback and claim it in connectedCallback.
